segments.name: Biotechnology
segments.description: Develops and commercializes cell therapies, principally CARVYKTI (cilta-cel), for patients with blood cancers such as multiple myeloma.
segments.evidence: The Company entered into the Janssen Agreement to develop and commercialize cilta-cel.

revenueModel.text: Legend Biotech earns license and milestone revenue from collaboration partners such as Janssen and Novartis, plus its pro-rata share of collaboration net trade sales of CARVYKTI for which Janssen is the principal selling to customers.
revenueModel.evidence: Collaboration revenue includes the Company's pro-rata share of collaboration net trade sales for which Janssen is the principal in the sale to the customers under Janssen Agreement.
